verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation or examples of Sentry's issue search/query syntax (e.g., tag:, release:, environment: filters) despite this being a core, well-known Sentry capability; only tangential items like issue status, bulk mutate API, and ownership rules are present, none of which describe a query language for cross-project search. missing for 10: no docs on search syntax, no examples of filtering by tag/release/environment/custom properties, no cross-project search evidence.
